Privacy & demo information

A demonstration.
Your health stays yours.

This public website explains the Edge-Care concept and a proposed pilot. It shows screenshots of the actual hosted app and links to the separate demonstration. This marketing website does not provide a clinical assessment.

Updated 14 November 2026

Screenshots and the hosted demonstration

The homepage shows screenshots captured from the actual Edge-Care hosted submission. Referral records shown are synthetic examples. Equity and digital-twin views display public-data indicators and planning simulations; they are not individual patient records or evidence of clinical effectiveness.

“Explore the experience” opens the separately hosted app at edgecare-lissankoiralas-projects.vercel.app. That app may process demo interactions, create synthetic records and use its own storage or services. Its operation is separate from this static marketing website. Do not enter real symptoms, personal documents, recordings, signatures or other patient information into the demo.

The static screenshots here do not create referrals or appointments. Any medical priority scores visible in them are unvalidated demonstration logic.

Information used by this website

This marketing website does not collect health information. We have not added advertising trackers, application analytics or an account system to this website. The marketing pages do not use browser storage.

As with other websites, the hosting provider may process technical information needed to serve and protect the site, such as request details, timestamps, browser information or IP addresses. This page does not make promises about the host’s logging or retention practices; those are governed by the provider’s applicable terms and policies.

Links to the hosted app, research papers, strategy documents and partner organisations open separately hosted websites. Their own privacy and cookie practices apply when you visit them.

Partnership information

The homepage provides a downloadable pilot brief and an outline for a partnership discussion. This website does not have an enquiry form or collect contact details.

Do not submit symptoms, medical histories, patient identifiers or confidential clinical material through a business discussion. This website is not monitored as a route for care.

A clinical pilot would be different

A future pilot would involve separate participant information and agreed clinical and data-governance arrangements before any health data is collected. These would identify the responsible organisations, permissions, processing purposes, access controls, retention, participant rights and contact points.

A patient code does not by itself make a health record anonymous. The proposed pilot would evaluate secure, recoverable access through a provider-approved record system. Identifiable clinical information would not be placed on a blockchain.

The pilot remains a proposal. Venues, clinical partners, funding and applicable approvals have not been confirmed by this website.

Clinical status and independence

Edge-Care is in development. Research discussed on this website concerns national priorities or other technologies and settings; it does not establish clinical effectiveness of the complete Edge-Care workflow.

The website is independently presented. References to AstraZeneca describe the relevance of its published priorities and a possible collaboration. They do not imply sponsorship, endorsement, clinical responsibility or access to patient records.
